nodes.title: Fictional demo references
widgets_values:
# Invented demo cast and places

Nine text-only CLOUD image calls: six adult anime parent heroes and three fictional environments. No photographs or image inputs are connected. These outputs become the sample upload references. Review the nine images, copy them to the comfyui/ref/demo/ paths in plan.json, and upload each under its cfz-demo-<id>.png name before validating/running the separate game-art factory.

Only The Yard is enabled in the default game. The other two sample environments are available for later uploads; their main-template slots remain empty and disabled. Preparing this graph spends nothing. Running requires spending authorization.
